Bill.BriefDescription: Establishing vehicle engine displacement and emissions fees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to establishing vehicle engine displacement andemissions fees; adding new sections to chapter 46.17 RCW; providingeffective dates; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) A vehicle engine displacement fee must be paid and collectedannually for motor vehicles subject to the fee under RCW 46.16.0621,except motor homes. The amount of the fee must be based upon thevehicle engine size in liters, which is correlated with vehicle sizeand vehicle emissions. The fee imposed under this section must be usedfor transportation purposes, and may not be used for the generalsupport of state government. The vehicle engine displacement fee isthat portion of the fee, as reflected on the engine size in liters setforth in the schedule provided in this section, that is in excess ofthe fees imposed under RCW 46.16.0621 and 46.17.010. For vehiclesregistered on or after January 1, 2009, the vehicle engine displacementfee under this section is due at the time of initial vehicleregistration and any subsequent renewal of vehicle registration. p. 1 SB 6900

(3) The vehicle engine displacement fee under this section isimposed to provide funds to mitigate the impact of vehicle loads on thestate roads and highways, as well as encourage the reduction of vehicleemissions and is separate and distinct from other vehicle license fees. (4) The vehicle engine displacement fee collected under thissection must be deposited into the multimodal transportation account.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText:
(1) A vehicle emissions fee must be paid and collected annually formotor vehicles subject to the fee under RCW 46.16.0621, except motorhomes. The amount of the fee must be based upon the grams of carbondioxide (CO2) emission per mile. Fees imposed under this section mustbe used for transportation purposes, and may not be used for thegeneral support of state government. The vehicle emissions fee is thatportion of the fee, as reflected on the grams of carbon dioxide (CO2)emission per mile set forth in the schedule provided in this section,that is in excess of the fees imposed under RCW 46.16.0621 and SB 6900 p. 2 46.17.010. On or after January 1, 2012, the vehicle emissions feeunder this section is due at the time of initial vehicle registrationand any subsequent renewal of vehicle registration.
